text: the LP flex i want to see next week: full 7-day wallet PnL, not one fee screenshot. show what went in, what came out, fees claimed and the value still sitting in positions. a big fee day can look great while the token side is underwater.

sources.claim: Meteora DLMM API provides portfolio PnL and position history for deposits, withdrawals and fee claims.

source_reply: Meteora’s DLMM data API exposes portfolio PnL and position histories, including adds, removes and fee claims: https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dlmm/api-reference/overview
note: Original Sunday view about what LP receipts to seek next week. No quoted account, wallet result or invented experience. Official Meteora API docs support the accounting fields.
